entries.title: Mobile-friendly UI
entries.details: The full website is now usable on mobile and touch devices. The navbar collapses into a hamburger menu, all tools pages and panels adapt to small screens, and desktop-only cards are hidden on mobile.

entries.title: Anarchy Industries Tools Store
entries.details: A public subscription store is now live. Non-JOE members can subscribe to access Astrogation, Hyper Planner, Entity Stats, Targeting Heatmap, and DroidBrain. Individual and Faction subscription plans are available.

entries.title: Public subscriber tool access
entries.details: Subscribers now have their own tools overview with access to Astrogation, Hyper Planner, Entity Stats, and Targeting Heatmap. Subscriber-specific galaxy map overlays and cell notes are included.

entries.title: Biometrics skill planner
entries.details: Fleet Command now includes a biometrics skill planner tab, letting you plan out skill point spending from your current baseline and see the total XP cost.

entries.title: Admin: subscription management
entries.details: Sysadmins can now view, grant, and revoke individual and faction tool subscriptions directly from the Users admin panel.

entries.title: Admin: worker health improvements
entries.details: Worker health panel now monitors the DroidBrain payment queue separately, includes per-queue warn thresholds, and adds actions to retry failed payments and recover stuck imports. The background worker has been split from 1 into 5 dedicated workers — XML imports, SWC sync, search indexing, payment reconciliation, and default queue — improving reliability and preventing slow jobs from blocking others.

entries.title: DroidBrain reward performance fix
entries.details: Fixed a query explosion where entity counts were being classified per scan row instead of per unique coordinate, preventing worker crashes on large uploads.

entries.title: SWC token revoke resilience
entries.details: SWC authorization token revocation now handles connection errors gracefully instead of crashing, logging the failure and returning a clean error state.

entries.title: Infrastructure: worker split and management commands
entries.details: The single background worker has been split into 5 dedicated containers — XML imports, SWC sync, search indexing, payment reconciliation, and default queue. dev.sh and prod.sh now include individual restart commands for each worker and the scheduler (worker-xml-restart, worker-swc-restart, worker-search-restart, worker-payment-restart, worker-default-restart, scheduler-restart). Two new scheduled backend tasks were also added: droidbrain:recover-stuck-uploads runs every 15 minutes, and ProcessAllPendingPaymentsJob runs daily at 03:00.

entries.title: Faction subscription automation
entries.details: Faction subscriptions now automatically grant the buyer or manager as the first member seat. Revoking a subscription removes all member grants immediately and enforces a 7-day cooldown before resubscription. Subscriptions that reach their period end are automatically expired hourly and all member grants are cleaned up. The About Me page now shows a Subscriber pill and only shows the Astrogation SWC access card to active subscribers.
